questions.q: What does Johnny Storm shout when he ignites?
questions.why: 'Flame on!' is the cry Johnny uses to set himself alight.

questions.q: Johnny's older sister is which Fantastic Four member?
questions.why: Johnny's older sister is Sue Storm, the Invisible Woman.

questions.q: Which actor played Johnny Storm in the 2005 Fantastic Four film?
questions.why: Chris Evans played Johnny Storm in the 2005 film.

questions.q: How old was Johnny when cosmic radiation gave him his powers?
questions.why: Johnny was 16 when cosmic radiation gave him his powers.

questions.q: In which year did Johnny debut in Fantastic Four #1?
questions.why: Fantastic Four #1 carried a November 1961 cover date.

questions.q: Which wall-crawling hero is Johnny's friend and frequent ally, roughly his age?
questions.why: Spider-Man is Johnny's friend and frequent ally.

questions.q: The 1939 android Human Torch that Johnny reinvented was created by whom?
questions.why: Johnny was created as a reinvention of Carl Burgos's android Torch.

questions.q: What is the name for Johnny's maximum heat output, unleashed in every direction at once?
questions.why: Johnny's top-power release, the nova, is his maximum output.

questions.q: Whom did Johnny help recover his memory in Fantastic Four #4?
questions.why: Johnny helped the amnesiac Namor regain his memory.

questions.q: In which year did Johnny's apparent death occur in Fantastic Four #587?
questions.why: Johnny's apparent death was shown in Fantastic Four #587 (March 2011).
